sessions.label: Order
sessions.title: Check out the carts; check the pantry

tasks.text: Check out WebstaurantStore (the free Plus trial takes about $69 off; cancel before it renews)
Check out the Amazon Prime cart
Check out Amazon Fresh with a delivery slot by Fri Nov 13
Pantry: 5.25 lb white chocolate, 1.75 lb bittersweet, 9 fl oz vanilla, 3.5 oz baking soda, 2.75 oz baking powder, 3.5 oz salt, spices
Candy thermometer you trust (220°F preserves, 245°F caramel, 75–78°F creme)
Start first: reduce 4.2 L Mexican Coke to ~595 g syrup in two wide pans, ~2 h at a simmer; cool, jar, refrigerate
Black & White ×4 as two double batches of each dough; chill 20 min
Test sheet (check the vanilla half's spread), then 8 sheets in 4 rounds, ~13 min
Cool and freeze airtight
Crinkle doughs ×7 with the cold syrup, as few doughs as the bowl allows
Roll 168 balls (~30 g) in sugar
Test sheet (soapy or metallic → cut baking soda to 8 g/batch), then 14 sheets in 7 rounds, ~11 min
Cool and freeze

sessions.title: Cherry syrup, preserves, Lime Rickey Drops ×7
sessions.buy: 7 eggs, 30 oz sour cream, 21 limes, 1 lemon

tasks.text: Start the wild cherry syrup: ½ Art of Drink recipe (~14 g bark, 15 ml glycerin, 60 ml water); macerate 24 h
Lime Rickey doughs ×7; chill 30 min
While it chills: preserves (800 g sour cherries, 400 g sugar, 1½ Tbsp lemon juice) to 220°F, ~30 min; cool, refrigerate
Scoop 168 at ~30 g; test sheet, then 7 rounds, ~10 min
Cool and freeze unglazed
Finish syrup: strain, re-steep bark in 60 ml warm water 1 h, strain, add cherry juice, top up, dissolve sugar cold
Thumbprint doughs ×5; roll 180 balls (~19 g), press wells, chill on sheets
Filling: warm preserves + 10 Tbsp syrup, simmer to thick jam, cool; acid phosphate drop by drop to taste (note the count)
Fill ~½ tsp each; 10 sheets in 5 rounds, ~13 min
Cool and freeze undusted

sessions.label: Shop
sessions.title: Stores close for Thanksgiving
sessions.buy: 4 qt heavy cream, 13 eggs, 1 pint whole milk

tasks.text: Pans ready: seven 9×13, or three half sheets + one 9×13
Crusts ×7 as two doughs; bake 2 pans at a time, ~25 min; cool
Caramel round 1: a double batch in each of two 6 qt pots to 245°F, 45–60 min; off heat stir in Hires, vanilla, star anise; pour over 4 crusts
Caramel round 2: a double and a single the same way; pour over the last 3; set ~2 h
Thin white-chocolate layer (100 g per pan), flaky salt; set
Cut 24 per pan with a hot knife; freeze between parchment
Wafer doughs ×7; roll 1/16 in. between parchment; chill 30 min
Cut 336 rounds; test sheet (crisp all the way through), then ~14 sheets in 7 rounds, ~14 min
Cool completely and freeze airtight (no creme yet)
Black & White ×3: one double and one single of each dough; chill 20 min
6 sheets in 3 rounds, ~13 min; cool and freeze

sessions.label: Buffer
sessions.title: Re-bake anything that didn't work, or take it off

tasks.text: Wed night: move the Lime Rickey Drops to the counter, closed, to thaw
Glaze (powdered sugar, lime juice, citric acid); dip 168 tops, zest, set 30 min; store airtight
Before bed: move the other five cookies to the counter, closed, to thaw
Re-crisp 336 wafers at 325°F, 3–4 min, 7 rounds; cool completely
Egg Cream creme ×7 in 2–3 rounds: melt (110°F max), cool to 75–78°F, whip pale, fold in popping candy; pipe ~16 g, sandwich 168
Dust the thumbprints with powdered sugar
Pack: 6 of each cookie per unit; bars and sandwiches on top
Note in each tin: eat the Egg Cream sandwiches first, freeze the rest
